name: What is the typical cost to widen a laundry room doorway in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost to widen a laundry room doorway in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to widen a laundry room doorway in the Bay Area varies depending on several factors, including the existing wall material (drywall, plaster, load-bearing vs. non-load-bearing), the required structural modifications, and the type of finish work. Projects can range from $1,500 to $4,500 or more. This estimate usually includes demolition, framing, drywall repair, and painting. A precise quote requires an on-site assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs for widening a laundry room doorway in the Bay Area typically range from $1,500 to $4,500, varying based on wall type and structural needs.
